desc: The Weaver No Gunsmith Shotgun Mount is ideally suited for any gunman. It is compatible with all products in the Weaver line of riflescopes and mounting accessories. The newly designed mount can be easily made to fit your favorite shotgun and will endure all of the wear and tear you put it through while on the hunt. Now you can make your devices work harder than ever before using this high-grade, durable mount. Made to fit your hardware perfectly, these designs are the epitome of high-end Weaver style.
